info.title: Welcome to the Movie Forum!
descriptions: This web app is designed for movie and TV series fans. Currently, the site features a catalog of quizzes categorized by franchise with filtering, sorting, and search capabilities.
Users can take a quiz and see the correct answers with explanations immediately, as well as overall quiz statistics after completing it.
Future plans include expanding the quiz system with the ability to create custom quizzes and adding a full catalog of films.
